description: This file defines the SensorLiveGraph class, a Swing JPanel component for visualizing sensor data in real-time, including UI interactions, data collection, and graph rendering.

classes.name: SensorLiveGraph
classes.description: A Swing JPanel subclass that displays real-time sensor data as a graph, with UI controls for sensor selection, refresh rate, and scaling options.

classes.name: SensorLiveGraph.ChangePeriod
classes.description: Enum representing different refresh intervals for the sensor data graph.

classes.name: SensorLiveGraph.VisibleRange
classes.description: Helper class for determining the min and max values displayed on the graph.

methods.name: SensorLiveGraph
methods.description: Constructor initializing the graph with configuration, default sensor, and extra menu item.

methods.name: createRunnable
methods.description: Creates a background runnable that periodically fetches sensor data.

methods.name: grabNewValue
methods.description: Fetches the latest sensor value and updates the graph.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Displays context menu for sensor and scale adjustments.

methods.name: addChangePeriodItems
methods.description: Adds menu items to change the refresh period.

methods.name: addChangeSensorItems
methods.description: Adds menu items to select different sensors.

methods.name: setSensor
methods.description: Sets the current sensor and clears data.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a new sensor value to the data list.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Custom painting of the graph and labels.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Determines the current display range based on auto-scaling or custom settings.

methods.name: paintLastValue
methods.description: Draws the latest sensor value on the graph.

methods.name: paintGraph
methods.description: Draws the sensor data points and connecting lines.
